Personal defaults override these values without changing past entries. Foods 1-1,000 are the original reviewed catalog; foods 1,001-5,000 add generic USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 foods and, where FNDDS has no equivalent, USDA SR Legacy (April 2018) foods listed in additionalSources. Foods 5,001 onward are brand-name products and restaurant-chain items named with their brand; their values reflect USDA analyses (SR Legacy items are 2018 or earlier) and may not match current formulations.
